task: 六种美术风格同场景对照图
purpose: 概念比较；非正式角色身份、非Meshy模型、非实机证据
acceptance: 每图含人物、敌人、武器、终端/门/炮塔、环境
逐图检查并保留原始图像

images.label: 电影感工业写实
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone landscape 16:9 high quality art-direction comparison illustration for the original cooperative tactical science-fiction game BREACH ECHO. This is a proposed visual target, not a screenshot or final character design. One coherent full-bleed scene, NOT a collage, no panels, no text, no logos, no UI.
LOCKED SUBJECTS AND COMPOSITION across six independently made styles: Eye-level 35mm-equivalent wide view into a large ancient facility. In the LEFT foreground show a full-body adult human expedition specialist, including feet, at about 65 percent of image height, three-quarter facing camera/right. Short dark hair, non-specific original face, practical off-white hard chest/shoulder armor over a dark teal fabric suit, orange neck cloth, tool belt, compact backpack. Both hands naturally hold a compact utilitarian rifle at low ready. Their face, hands, clothing, gun and posture must be clearly readable. In the RIGHT foreground show one large ORIGINAL hostile non-humanoid creature, fully visible at about 50 percent of image height, crouching facing left: low heavy body, four powerful articulated legs, two small sensory forelimbs, asymmetric pale mineral-like dorsal plates, charcoal/teal organic underside, a small exposed warm-colored throat organ; animal anatomy, not a robot, not a familiar franchise monster, no gore. Leave visible space between soldier and enemy.
In CENTER midground, another smaller helmeted teammate stands at a waist-high powered terminal beside a heavy mechanical door. Include a small deployable turret with clear tripod legs near the terminal. In BACKGROUND, enormous continuous ancient stone/ceramic arches dwarf the rectilinear human maintenance platform, railings, a few cables and pipes. Keep the floor and path legible. A modest warm practical light by the terminal and restrained cool ambient light reveal surfaces; do NOT smother the scene in fog or near-black shadow. Compose as an art-director's polished representative scene in which people, enemy, weapon, interactable machinery, and world architecture all belong to the same visual language. Maintain these subject counts, proportions of screen coverage, relative positions and camera across the series. Stylistic rendering and shape simplification may differ strongly. No cropped feet, no unreadably tiny people, no enormous muzzle flash, no large text labels.
STYLE FOR THIS IMAGE:
Photorealistic cinematic industrial science fiction. Believable physically based materials and anatomy, natural human proportions and facial structure, finely woven cloth, scuffed painted metal with restrained realistic wear, precise machined gun, convincing skin and translucent organic tissue. Real camera optics with everything important sufficiently in focus, realistic contact shadows, soft indirect illumination, tactile roughness differences. Desaturated steel, warm ivory, oxidized teal and small amber highlights. Detailed but professionally maintained environment, ominous grounded creature. Could be a carefully art-directed live-action production still or exceptionally high-fidelity 3D cinematic. NO illustration outlines, no cel shading, no painterly strokes, no exaggerated cartoon anatomy. Clear enough to assess details, not a pitch-dark horror poster.
